IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL NOS.3560-3561 OF 2009
(Arising out of S.L.P. (C) Nos.6060-6061 of 2008)
Satyendra Kumar (Dead) Thr. L.Rs.             ...Appellant(s)
Versus
Mast Ram Uniyal (Dead) Thr. L.Rs.
      ...Respondent(s)
O  R  D  E  R
Leave granted.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
By  the  impugned  order,  the  High  Court,  though  framed  substantial 
question of law involved in second appeals but without deciding the same, allowed the 
appeals and remitted the matter to the First Appellate Court.  In our view, on this 
ground alone, the impugned order is fit to be set aside.
Accordingly, the appeals are allowed, impugned order rendered by the 
High Court is set aside and the matter is remanded to it to decide second appeals in 
accordance with law after giving opportunity of hearing to the parties.
......................J.
      [B.N. AGRAWAL]
......................J.
      [G.S. SINGHVI]
......................J.
      [DR. B.S. CHAUHAN]
New Delhi,
May 14, 2009.
